//ConnectionStrings: Set via env vars in production: ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection and ConnectionStrings__HangfireConnection (use double-underscore to nest).
//Jwt: Set the actual signing key via env var Jwt__Secret (32+ bytes random). Issuer/Audience may be overridden via Jwt__Issuer / Jwt__Audience.
//DeviceFingerprint: Set DeviceFingerprint__Salt via env var (32+ bytes random).
//Cors: Set Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 (and __1, __2, ...) via env vars to your actual SPA origins. NEVER use * for AllowedOrigins in production with credentials.
//CreditControl: At SO confirmation, block if outstanding AR (BDT) + the order value exceeds Customer.CreditLimit. CreditLimit=0 means no limit set (not enforced). Set Enabled=false to disable entirely, or BlockOverLimit=false to make the check advisory (never block).
//AuditLogRetention: Nightly trim job @ 02:30. Set RetentionDays=0 to disable. BatchSize/MaxBatchesPerRun bound the per-run work; defaults safe for ~5M-row tables.
//DatabaseBackup: Nightly full backup @ 01:30 + RESTORE VERIFYONLY + retention cleanup. BackupDirectory = path AS SEEN BY SQL SERVER (empty = SQL's default backup dir, cleanup skipped). CleanupDirectory = same dir AS SEEN BY THE API (only needed when SQL runs on another host/container — docker-compose wires both). Compress requires Standard+ edition (NOT Express). COPY THE .bak FILES OFFSITE — a backup on the same disk as the DB does not survive a disk failure.
//MonthlyStatements: 06:00 on the 1st — emails last month's statement PDF to every active customer (and optionally supplier) with activity + an email on file. OPT-IN: flip Enabled to true once the business wants it. Requires a real Email provider (Smtp) — with DevLogger it only logs. CcAddresses = internal accounts inbox.
//OperationalAlerts: Daily 07:00 sweep raising notifications for low stock (RM ≤ MinimumStockLevel / Product ≤ ReorderLevel), overdue invoices, and expiring compliance certs. Channel=InApp records to the Notifications viewer only; set Channel=Email + Recipient=<address> (needs Smtp provider) to actually email. DedupDays suppresses a repeat of the same alert within N days.
//Dunning: Daily 08:00 — emails customers about overdue invoices, escalating tone by age (First ≥FirstReminderDays, Second ≥SecondNoticeDays, Final ≥FinalNoticeDays). OPT-IN: flip Enabled=true once collections reminders are wanted; needs a real Email provider (Smtp) — DevLogger only logs. DedupDays suppresses a repeat for the same invoice within N days. CcAddresses = internal collections inbox.

Sms.//Provider: Set to Twilio / Vonage / etc. in production. DevLogger writes to logs only.

Email.//Provider: Set to Smtp / SendGrid / etc. in production. DevLogger writes to logs only.

//Database: Set Database__InitializeOnStartup=true to auto-apply EF migrations + run idempotent seeder on container boot. Recommended for fresh deploys; toggle off once stable.
